name: Sausage Balls
description: Crispy sausage and cheddar balls perfect for snacking or parties, made with biscuit mix and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the sausage in a frying pan until fully cooked.
Add the cheddar soup to the browned sausage and stir until well mixed.
Combine the sausage mixture with the biscuit mix and blend until a dough forms.
Form the dough into small balls (about 50 total).
Place the sausage balls on a cookie sheet and bake in a preheated 450°F oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

keywords: sausage balls, cheddar soup, biscuit mix, party snack

_similar.name: Spinach Dip
_similar.description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

_similar.keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread

_similar.name: Rumaki
_similar.description: Classic rumaki appetizer featuring bacon-wrapped water chestnuts baked in a ketchup and brown sugar glaze.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the pound of bacon in half.
Wrap bacon around chestnuts and secure with toothpicks.
Bake at 350°F for ½ hour.
Drain grease.
Mix ketchup and brown sugar.
Pour mixture over chestnuts and bake for another ½ hour.

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.
